pr_title: Initialize empty schedules when calling `.in_schedule` if they do not already exist
pr_body:
# Objective
Fixes [#7910](#https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/issues/7910)

## Solution
create shedule if it does not exist by the time `add_system` called

My first PR. Not sure how much this solution feet here but at least it seems to work. Any comment is appreciated.
pr_comments:
**Welcome**, new contributor!

  Please make sure you've read our [contributing guide](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and we look forward to reviewing your pull request shortly ✨

> create set if it does not exist by the time add_system called

This is not correct; you're creating a `Schedule` :)

> > create set if it does not exist by the time add_system called
> 
> This is not correct; you're creating a `Schedule` :)

My mistake in PR description. Fixed it.
also, maybe same changes might be applied in [`add_systems`](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/main/crates/bevy_app/src/app.rs#L428) ?

> also, maybe same changes might be applied in [`add_systems`](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/main/crates/bevy_app/src/app.rs#L428) ?

Yes, definitely. And agreed with James about the doc comments: I think `.in_schedule` is the best place for that.
Isn't this part covered with some tests that also need to be updated? I can't find any...

> Isn't this part covered with some tests that also need to be updated? I can't find any...

I'm not surprised if there aren't any: we tend not to test this sort of end-user API super hard since it gets caught readily in the examples.

That said, I'd be happy to see a pair of tests for this behavior, one for the single system case and the other for multiple systems.
how can I test that system runs on a specified schedule? Like in this example, to test that it runs not on default?
Use `app.world.run_schedule(MySchedule)` and then verify that the world was mutated as expected :)

> That said, I'd be happy to see a pair of tests for this behavior, one for the single system case and the other for multiple systems.

should these tests be integration tests, in `bevy_app/tests` or it will be ok to place them in [crates/bevy_app/src/app.rs test section](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/9c98f8adc35879977fca3a5ea1eadbcb75e4fbe8/crates/bevy_app/src/app.rs#L1016) ?
The last one will work great here :)

> Yes, definitely. And agreed with James about the doc comments: I think `.in_schedule` is the best place for that.

maybe for `add_system` as well?

> thread 'main' panicked at 'Schedule OnEnter(Init) does not exist.', /home/set/.cargo/git/checkouts/bevy-f7ffde730c324c74/43ea6f2/crates/bevy_app/src/app.rs:393:17
> 
> I have few places where it might probably be causing:
> ```rust
> .add_system(init_configs.in_schedule(OnEnter(GameStates::Init)));
> ```
> 
> and 
> ```rust
> .add_system(bullet_init.in_schedule(OnEnter(GameStates::Init)))
> ```
> 
> which both looks similar. Is there something wrong with how I use in_schedule and OnEnter here? What might be the cause of this error?
